defects: The deeper dish is still hard to read in the installed production view, and the seat remains a broad slab instead of the target’s carved, integrated seat-and-rim form.
Leaf-profile spindles are now broad, but the crest and back joints remain simplified and the turned leg/stretcher profiles lack the target’s distinct bead and collar construction.
The chair finish is more balanced than v005, but grain is too fine and uniform across each part, without knots or member-level variation; walnut posts remain dark.
Visible pegs mark joins but the construction still lacks convincing fitted shoulders and carved transitions.
hard_fail_reasons: The target’s carved seat shaping, profiled joinery and individual wood variation remain materially underrepresented; the candidate still reads as procedural review art rather than production furniture.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v005, v006 uses flattened leaf-profile back spindles, a deeper dished seat and a chair-specific satin wood shader. The chair-specific finish reduces the orange cast, restores visible oak/walnut separation and makes the custom surfaces read coherently. The production views still show a restrained, almost flat-looking seat center, high-frequency grain that lacks target knots and carved board variation, a thin simple crest, and dark rear posts. These changes improve the best review candidate but do not satisfy the production realism or craftsmanship gates.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog the transfer after the third round-02 attempt. Resume only with a materially different production backend or authored texture workflow that can reproduce the target’s carved seat rim, component-specific bead/collar joinery, and distinctive board grain; retain v006 as the best review candidate and do not promote it.

observations.art_direction_fit: The candidate now carries the round-02 target’s broad leaf-spindle vocabulary and warm brown timber, but misses its richly carved joinery and individually varied finish.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail view shows a more nuanced satin wood response and leaf-shaped spindles, but the center dish, bead/collar transitions and broad joint shoulders remain understated.
observations.gameplay_readability: At gameplay distance, seat/back/frame parts separate more clearly than in v004 and the chair type is unambiguous.
observations.geometric_detail: The deeper dished seat, flattened leaf spindles, curved crest, turned legs and closed ends are authored; the target’s carved rim, turned collars and fitted joints remain simplified.
observations.material_realism: The chair-specific finish removes the strong orange cast and separates oak from walnut, but the grain looks overly fine and the rear walnut parts remain too dark.
observations.proportion: The mesh measures 23.58 x 18.71 x 20.75 inches, within the 25 x 19 x 23 inch brief, and has 0.058 inch positive floor clearance.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot reports dimensions 23.58 x 18.71 x 20.75 inches and a lowest y bound of 0.058 inch, inside the 25 x 19 x 23 inch envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The bowed crest, leaf-shaped spindles, broad seat, four splayed legs and lower stretchers read as a workshop chair from gameplay and close views.
observations.silhouette_quality: The fuller flattened spindle silhouettes approach the target more closely than v005, but the crest is thin and the low back still lacks the target’s strong turned-post shape.
observations.surface_variation: Grain is now visible on the seat, crest and members, but its dense repeated frequency lacks target knots, end grain and board-level variation.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 generation, validation and review-showcase rendering pass with 29 meshes, 29 surfaces, 74,752 triangles and no validation issues.

close_inspection.evidence: Close inspection shows weak seat dish, thin crest, low-contrast joints, generic turned transitions and uniform dense grain without the target’s knots or board variation.

edge_treatment.evidence: The seat rim is softened and the dish is deeper, but its center contour remains difficult to read and the target’s sculpted seat edge is still absent.

hardware.evidence: The target has no metal hardware; the wooden pins fit its construction, though they do not yet convey the target’s carved joinery.

joins.evidence: Pins identify the frame connections, but the post-to-seat and stretcher joints lack clear shoulders and fitted turned collars.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The leaf-profile spindles and closed turned members are progress; bead collars, carving, seat contour and fitted shoulders remain too simple for believable craftsmanship.

material_response.evidence: The chair finish has a satin highlight, but walnut posts are still too dark and the oak reads as finely striped instead of richly figured timber.

surface_variation.evidence: Grain appears on all wood members but repeats at a narrow, dense frequency and does not show the target’s knots or board-level changes.

thickness.evidence: The seat slab, crest, back posts, legs and stretchers retain continuous plausible thickness in the detail and oblique captures.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The leaf-shaped spindles and warm brown finish improve the chair, but the seat, crest and joints remain visibly procedural and the target’s wood construction is not carried into the render.

photo_character.evidence: The ArtBrief uses an approved generated target and has no source photograph.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Keep v006 as the best review candidate and backlog the transfer. A future pass should use a materially different mesh/texture workflow to build the target’s sculpted seat rim and fitted collars and apply board-level grain with knots and calmer, broader variation.
lost_visual_information: The target’s hand-shaped seat dish and rolled edge are reduced to a broad surface whose curvature is hard to read.
The turned posts, crest and stretcher joints lack the target’s bead collars, shoulders and convincing fitted construction.
The target’s individually varied wood boards and visible knots are reduced to repeated fine lines across the chair.
preserved_components: The chair has the target’s principal parts, low silhouette, flattened back spindles and curved crest.
The corrected mesh winding, closed ends, rounded seat rim and positive floor clearance are preserved within the exact brief envelope.
